newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Magnificent in convertible bonds issue.
newsitem.headline: Magnificent in convertible bonds issue.

text.p: Property firm Magnificent Estates Ltd said on Friday it proposed to issue HK$223.72 million of 5.0 percent mandatorily convertible bonds at a conversion price of HK$0.23 per share.
Shun Ho Construction (Holdings) Ltd, the controlling shareholder of Magnificent, and Henderson Land Development Co Ltd agreed to subscribe 15.3 percent each, the company said in a statement.
The remaining HK$155.17 million in bonds would be offered to existing shareholders in the proportion of three units of bond at HK$0.23 each for every 10 shares held, it said.
Shun Ho, which has a 48.1 percent stake in Magnificent, has agreed to subscribe 324.55 million units of the bonds worth HK$74.65 million alloted to the company, Magnificent said.
It said Shun Ho also agreed to underwrite the balance of the bonds under the rights issue to shareholders.
Assuming full conversion of the bonds, shareholding of Shun Ho in Magnificent will rise to 48.3 percent, it said.
The company said proceeds would be used to finance expansion of its development and investment property portfolio in Hong Kong and for its residential and commercial development in Shanghai.
Magnificent shares were at HK$0.315 each at midday, down HK$0.025 or 7.35 percent from Thursday's close.
